decisions.reason: The rebranding to 518 FLEX after strong further development and the statement that the machine had already won many supporters suggest performance at or above aspiration, so a resource-constrained but established German machinery firm would likely retain it.

Although it was less prominently featured in 2019, the rollout of the whole AK series with EU Stage V technology indicates continued commitment and acceptable results relative to aspiration, making withdrawal unlikely absent stronger failure signals.

Its move from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 points to growing internal confidence and market acceptance, so management would probably keep searching for sales growth rather than abandon a core-fit mobile grinder.

The CERON line was still prominently presented in 2019 with language about setting standards and evidence of concrete application, implying results clearly above aspiration and a strong strategic fit with the firm's stationary recycling-solutions business.
